_doc: BARLING dating cabinet = DATA only (cabinet #8, built 2026-07-16 following control/CABINET_METHOD.md incl. step-1b sweep). Barling dates by ERA CLIFFS: Pre-Transition (family, -1962) / Transition (1963-c.1970) / Post-Transition (Denmark, 1970s+) / Kopp revival (2020+, lion's-head stem). Sharpest rules: 4-digit shape starting '1' = Pre-Transition, other 4-digit = Transition+; 'EB WB' hallmarked silver = exact year (generic.json charts pending). SOURCES: smokingpipes.com 'About Barling Pipes: A Pocket Guide' (2022, updated 2020 -- Farid's link, extract mirrored to brand_research/barling_dating/) leaning on Tad Gage (P&T Spring 2000); pipedia mirror staging/pipedia/Barling.json + Loring_s_Barling_Collection.json; pipephil logo-barling.html. ⚠️ THE KOPP TRAP: the 2020 revival reuses the old grade names (Fossil/Ye Olde Wood/TVF/Guinea Grain) as FINISHES -> grade names alone never date a Barling; the lion's-head stem inlay = modern, its absence + old nomenclature = vintage.

history_anchors._doc: 1812 Benjamin Barling (silversmith) opens in Portland Place, Marylebone -- silver-mounting meerschaums, then briars from the mid-1800s. EARLY 1900s: own briar production begins (Camden Town). Montague Barling after WWI (mainly straight shapes -- Billiards/Pots). 1940s: Barling Nichols era -- US expansion, 'Ye Olde Wood' + 'The Very Finest' popularized, grade/size/shape stamps added post-WWII. 1960 sold to FINLAY; family control until LATE 1962 = PRE-TRANSITION END. 1963 Imperial Tobacco full control = TRANSITION (end disputed: late '60s or 1970). 1970s+: Isle of Man HQ, pipes MADE IN DENMARK = POST-TRANSITION. Then dormant. 2020: KOPP PIPES revival (lion's-head sterling stem inlay; series Admiral/Trafalgar/Nelson/Ivory/Marylebone; Bark finish = aluminum accents). Factory records thin (fire). Filter lines: Trotube, CYG-Smoker. Quaints = hand-carved partial rustication (1930s+), never stamped 'Quaint'.

brand_marks.physical: Vintage: 'BARLING'S MAKE' with Barling's ARCHED over Make; sizes SS/S/S-M/L/EL/EXEL/EXEXEL; LF/LLF Canadians; silver 'EB WB' + London hallmarks; pre-WWII stems (vulcanite/horn/amber) have a SMALL ROUND smoke hole, post-WWII = elongated slot. Kopp revival: sterling LION'S HEAD inlaid in the stem (Bark finish = aluminum accents instead of silver).

table.note: Post-Transition production moved to Denmark from the 1970s; end unknown (brand went dormant before the 2020 revival) -- approx, verify
English production through the Transition; Post-Transition made in Denmark -> England wording = pre-c.1970 hint (LOW: revival/late stamps unverified)

line_years._notes: KOPP series (Trafalgar/Admiral/Nelson/Marylebone + Ivory meerschaums) = 2020+ HIGH. Vintage grade names are FLOORS ONLY (guide: the 1946-1962 grading system = YOW/Fossil/Special/Birds Eye/Guinea Grain/Straight Grain, SOME continued into Transition/Post-Transition, and ALL the names were revived by Kopp 2020 as finishes) -> never a ceiling from the name; the era comes from shape-number pattern / lion's head / hallmark / COM. birds eye: introduced 'during the later years when the company was still family owned' -> floor 1950 approx. 'special' NOT encoded (single generic word -- too collision-prone; confirm-flow). Trotube / CYG-Smoker / Quaint (never stamped) -> notes only. Pre-1946 pipes usually carry NO grade/shape stamps at all -- minimal nomenclature + round smoke hole + arched BARLING'S MAKE = pre-1946 profile (confirm-flow, not auto).

table.label: 4-digit shape starting with 1 = Pre-Transition (numbering began post-WWII under Nichols; family era ends late 1962)
4-digit shape NOT starting with 1 = 'almost always' Transition era or later (guide)
1-3 digit Nichols number = post-WWII floor (even-ending = tapered, odd = saddle -- inconsistent, hint only)
sterling lion's-head stem inlay = the Kopp revival marker (2020+)
'EB WB' silver maker's mark = Pre-Transition silverwork; the London hallmark beside it gives the EXACT year (generic.json charts pending -> confirm-flow)
small round smoke hole in the button = pre-WWII (elongated slot = post-war)

stamped_year._doc: Generic channel; Barling rarely stamps years, but hallmarked EB WB silver = exact year once UK charts land.
